8164.title: Native text preferences do not reach hosted typography
8164.rootCauseOneLine: The mobile WebView does not forward native font preferences to hosted typography; the hosted theme fixes text adjustment at 100%.

prReviews.verdict: Relevant proposed fix; runtime effectiveness unverified
prReviews.topFinding: Static diff adds native font preference injection and hosted typography/layout changes; the PR branch was not run.

8164.proposedFix: Forward native font preferences on WebView load and updates; validate enlarged editor and compact-control layouts on iOS. Existing linked PR #8168 prevents a duplicate fix PR.
8164.caveats: Protocol/injection probe repeated in two clean trusted checkouts. No iOS Simulator or working browser runtime; no screenshot or native pixel-level verification. Probe source and output are inline only, following report-repository rules.
